configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: Text
configurable_props.description: Enter static text (e.g., `hello world`) or a reference to a string exported by a previous step (e.g., `{{steps.foo.$return_value}}`).

configurable_props.name: useMarkdown
configurable_props.label: Use Markdown Format
configurable_props.description: Enable markdown formatting support. When enabled, the text will be parsed as markdown and converted to Google Docs formatting (headings, bold, italic, lists, etc.)
